verdict: Ads are efficient at 4.14x return; setup milestones need to close now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,849.56 on $1,411.96 in spend, a 4.14x return on ad spend, and efficiency improved another 10.9% week-over-week even as purchase volume held flat. That's a healthy signal — you're getting more out of every dollar — but growth in volume is stalled. Seven setup milestones from August and September (including conversion tracking, UTM tagging, and automated flows) remain incomplete, which means purchase and attribution data is likely under-reporting; clearing these is the immediate priority. Your Google Business Profile showed two days of zero recorded activity on October 20–21, which we're investigating as a possible data gap rather than a real drop in local interest. Expect those milestones to close ahead of the October 31 review, at which point conversion data will be reliable enough to make confident scaling decisions.
